# CapitalTrack

> CapitalTrack (https://zakgedi.github.io/capitaltrack/) is Nova Global's LP fundraising CRM: a pipeline board for the Nova III fundraise over a map of the institutional allocator (limited partner) universe - 357 endowments, foundations, family offices, pensions and sovereign wealth funds, with investment-team rosters, roles, contact details, AUM and locations.

## Machine-readable data

- [firms.json](https://zakgedi.github.io/capitaltrack/firms.json): manifest for the complete firm universe as structured JSON. Its `shards` array lists shard files (firms-1.json, firms-2.json, ...); each shard is a JSON array of firm objects, and concatenating the shards in order yields the full firms array (0-based index = the firm id used across the site). Per firm: name, type, location, aum, rank, description, notes, and contacts[] with name, role, email/orgEmail/personalEmail, linkedin, bio, and an `unverified` flag when a record is pattern-inferred or from a third-party directory. The same array ships to the app as firms-data.js.
- Live pipeline state is served by the site's public read/write API (PostgREST):
  - Base URL: https://pkiliwsmcxseoczfsfar.supabase.co/rest/v1
  - Required headers on every request: `apikey: sb_publishable_32d3KFrWN_SVr5sdEv7ekQ_1Ycwv5Qy` and `Authorization: Bearer sb_publishable_32d3KFrWN_SVr5sdEv7ekQ_1Ycwv5Qy` (publishable key; already public in the site's own JavaScript).
  - `GET /ct_pipeline?select=firm_id,stage,owner,tier,connection,notes` - one row per firm on the board. `firm_id` is the 0-based index into firms.json; custom LPs added in the app use ids 10001+. `stage` is one of Wishlist, Warm, Contacted, In Process, Committed. `tier` maps to stars: S=5, A=4, B=3, C=2, D=1. `stage_changed_at` (when present) is when the card entered its current stage.
  - `GET /ct_tags?select=id,name,color` and `GET /ct_card_tags?select=firm_id,tag_id` - card tags. Tags named High, Mid, Low are the card's priority designation.
  - `GET /ct_touches?select=id,firm_id,kind,note,owner,touched_at` - interaction log per LP. `kind` is email, call, meeting or note.
  - `GET /ct_firm_profiles?select=firm_id,min_commit,max_commit` - typical check-size range per firm, in US dollars.
  - `GET /ct_custom_firms?select=id,name,type,city,state,aum,notes` - LPs added in the app beyond the built-in universe. Board id = 10000 + row id.
  - `GET /ct_rankings?select=firm_id,elo,games` - head-to-head calibration ratings from the 1v1 page. `elo` is the calibrated rating (seeded from the engine order, updated Elo-style, K=24); `games` is how many pairings the firm has been in.
  - `GET /ct_commitments?select=firm_id,amount,fund` - LP commitments by fund. `amount` is in US dollars; `fund` is e.g. III.
  - `GET /ct_funds?select=fund,goal` - fundraising goals per fund (goal in US dollars).
  - Example: `curl -H "apikey: sb_publishable_32d3KFrWN_SVr5sdEv7ekQ_1Ycwv5Qy" -H "Authorization: Bearer sb_publishable_32d3KFrWN_SVr5sdEv7ekQ_1Ycwv5Qy" "https://pkiliwsmcxseoczfsfar.supabase.co/rest/v1/ct_touches?select=firm_id,kind,touched_at"`

## Pages

- [Pipe](https://zakgedi.github.io/capitaltrack/index.html): the pipeline board and root page. Two views: Stacks (board by stage) and List (every card ranked by stars, then High/Mid/Low priority). KPI band tracks $ and count by stage, touches, stale LPs and average days in stage. Cards carry data-id, data-stage, data-stars and data-priority attributes. The floating + button adds a card or a new LP.
- [Globe](https://zakgedi.github.io/capitaltrack/globe.html): interactive globe and searchable firm directory; opens as a modal from the masthead globe icon. Dots for LPs on the board are colored by stage.
- [1v1](https://zakgedi.github.io/capitaltrack/rank.html): head-to-head LP calibration; updates ct_rankings.
